user.title: Connect to Kiosky
user.description: Enter the external API base URL shown in Kiosky and a dedicated Kiosky API key (not a GitHub token).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Kiosky
reconfigure.description: Update the name or API key. To change the installation URL, remove this integration and add it again.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace Kiosky API key
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new API key in Kiosky and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: The Kiosky API key is invalid, revoked, or missing.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) API base URL without credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the external API URL, TLS certificate, and Kiosky version (3.3.1 or newer).

abort.already_configured: This Kiosky installation is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The installation URL cannot be changed. Remove this entry and add the new installation.
